basic_info.description: Residence #6E is a spacious 2bd/2ba offering a thoughtfully designed layout, from nearly every angle. The chef's kitchen is appointed with SieMatic cabinetry, top-of-the-line Gaggenau appliances, Caesarstone countertops, and an eat-in island ideal for casual dining. Just off the kitchen and dining area, a private deck offers peek-a-boo views of the Bay Bridge, perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding. From the living area, enjoy tranquil views of the lush courtyard gardens three stories below.  The expansive primary suite features a generous walk-in closet, additional linen storage, and a spa-like bath with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. The second bedroom offers a spacious layout large enough to have a bedroom and desk. Additional highlights include light wide-plank oak flooring, custom built-out closets, automated window treatments, an in-unit Bosch washer & dryer, private storage, and one valet parking space. Regarded as one of the premier amenity-rich buildings on the West Coast, Lumina offers over an acre of world-class features including a 70-foot heated lap pool, Jay Wright-designed fitness center, spa, bi-level club lounge, private dining room, movie theater, game room, children's playroom, rooftop terrace, and Woodlands Market.
